newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway stocks up, Fokus Bank most traded share.
newsitem.headline: Norway stocks up, Fokus Bank most traded share.

text.p: The Oslo Bourse rose sharply under influence from U.S. economic developments on Tuesday, but volume was moderate with takeover target Fokus Bank the most traded share for the second consecutive day.
Oslo's Total index closed 1.67 percent higher at 1,073.55 points in turnover of 884 million crowns, including 260 million in Fokus, Norway's four largest bank.
Fokus announced that higher interest income helped increase first-quarter after-tax profits by 56.5 percent to 182.5 million crowns from the same year-ago period.
The Fokus share fell 1.50 crowns to 73 crowns.

The bank moved forward the date for the announcement by 10 days after a hostile takeover bid on Monday by Sparebankgruppen, which consists of sixteen regional savings banks. They are bidding 73 crowns per share.

Industrial giant Norsk Hydro, the biggest listed company in Norway, was the second most traded share at 53 million crowns, rising 3.50 crowns to 329. Hydro will present its first-quarter results on Monday.
